append.detail: Under the Frequency design a signed-out visitor on /join?seq=, ?persona= or ?next= now gets the Join template's card (FrequencyJoin) inside the site shell instead of the DAWN induction; the funnel cohort and persona ride through the emailed link as the induction's own cookies, and the landing as ?to= on /join/complete. DAWN, signed-in members and the admin preview keep the induction unchanged.
